First, note: Asia/Riyadh currently uses UTC+3 (no DST). However, historical time zones before the 20th century are not standardized; Riyadh would have used local mean time roughly UTC+3:07 based on longitude (46°43'E). But for simplicity in such problems, we assume modern timezone rules unless stated otherwise.  

Given: March 22, 1478, 1:00 PM (13:00) in Asia/Riyadh (UTC+3).  
UTC = local time − offset = 13:00 − 3 hours = 10:00 UTC.  
Date remains March 22, 1478 (no crossing midnight).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1478-03-22 10:00
